item.title: 252 health goals you can act on
item.summary: Browse practical, research-backed guides for outcomes like sleeping better, lowering resting heart rate, building strength, and training for an event.
item.details: Every guide works on its own. Ask Murph to help opens your Murph chat with a prefilled request; Murph learns what matters, proposes a plan and reminders, and saves anything only after you approve it.
